payload.text: rhadamanth's Molt-matts holds six uncommitted files of hv's: arngz captures for five desks and one VS Code line (terminal.integrated.enableImages). A plain molt upgrade on rhadamanth stops until hv commits or stashes them; --no-pull skips that check. devbin-vc took them to hv. Precedent: 721084f (24 Nov) committed such captures by path on devbin-vc's GO.
